name: Merino Wool Crew Jumper
short_description: Mid-weight crew-neck knit in soft merino wool.
description: Knitted from a fine 12-gauge merino yarn, this crew-neck jumper is warm without the bulk and naturally breathable. A clean, versatile staple for cooler days.

name: Organic Cotton T-Shirt
short_description: Everyday tee in heavyweight organic cotton.
description: Cut from 220gsm organic cotton with a relaxed fit and a ribbed crew neck that holds its shape wash after wash.

name: Selvedge Denim Jeans
description: Woven on vintage shuttle looms, this raw selvedge denim breaks in to the wearer over time. Slim through the thigh with a straight leg and a button fly.

name: Lightweight Rain Jacket
description: A 2.5-layer waterproof shell that packs into its own pocket. Fully taped seams, an adjustable hood, and pit zips for when the climb gets warm.

name: Leather Card Holder
description: Hand-cut from vegetable-tanned leather that patinas beautifully. Three card slots and a central pocket in a profile slim enough for a front pocket.

name: Canvas Weekend Holdall
short_description: Waxed canvas holdall with leather trim.
description: Roomy enough for a long weekend, built from heavy waxed canvas with bridle leather handles and a brass zip. Wipes clean and only looks better with age.

name: Merino Beanie
description: A snug rib-knit beanie in itch-free merino wool, with a turn-back cuff for an adjustable fit. Warm, light, and quietly smart.

name: Stainless Water Bottle
description: Double-walled vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. A leak-proof cap and powder-coated finish that shrugs off knocks.

name: Stoneware Mug Set
short_description: Set of four reactive-glaze stoneware mugs.
description: Thrown in stoneware and finished in a speckled reactive glaze, so no two are quite alike. Dishwasher and microwave safe; a generous 350ml each.

name: Linen Throw Blanket
description: Woven from pure European linen and stonewashed for a soft, lived-in handle. Light enough for summer evenings, with a loose fringe finish.

name: Soy Wax Candle
description: A natural soy wax blend with a cotton wick and a warm cedar-and-amber scent. Hand-poured in small batches for a clean, even 50-hour burn.

name: Cast Iron Skillet
description: A workhorse 26cm skillet, pre-seasoned and ready to use. Holds and spreads heat evenly from hob to oven, and lasts a lifetime with simple care.
